title: Cartoons Published
summary: The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age published cartoons on August 12, 2026, and August 11, 2026. The Sydney Morning Herald also published a Superquiz on Wednesday, August 12. The Age published a similar Superquiz. The cartoons and Superquiz were available on their respective websites, SMH.com.au and The Age.
summary_points: The Sydney Morning Herald published cartoons on August 12, 2026.
The Age published cartoons on August 11, 2026.
The Sydney Morning Herald published a Superquiz on Wednesday, August 12.
The Age also published a Superquiz.
The content was available on SMH.com.au and The Age.
